scale_cues: Stainless steel mixing bowl filling most of the frame (assumed ~25-28 cm rim diameter) on a scale/tray; whole olives (~2-2.5 cm long, ~4 g each) used as an internal size reference for the chicken cubes (~35-40 pieces).
assumptions: White cubed pieces are cooked chicken breast rather than tofu, turkey, or cheese, based on fibrous texture and browned edges
Dark oval items are Kalamata-type olives; counted about 9 at ~4 g each, treated as edible mass (pits, if present, not subtracted)
Chicken is a single loose layer with some overlap, about 35-40 cubes at ~2-3 g each
No visible sauce or dressing; only a trace of oil or brine assumed
Bowl size is assumed from typical mixing bowl dimensions as no cutlery or hand is in frame
